Outdoor_lamp_controller.label: Outdoor lamp controller
Outdoor_lamp_controller.description: The uCIFI outdoor lamp controller object provides attributes to control, command and monitor outdoor luminaires in streets, in tunnels, on roads and for illumination of park and gardens.

Command.label: Command
Command.description: Command (e.g. manual override, scheduler) sent to the outdoor lamp controller.

Command_in_action.label: Command in action
Command_in_action.description: For outdoor lighting applications, the command in action (this resource) may differ from a command that was sent (resource ID: 1), due to LPWAN network constraints and/or light adjustments within the lamp’s control gear (e.g. virtual power settings). The command in action is the actual value of the command in action in the outdoor lamp controller.

Dimming_level.label: Dimming level
Dimming_level.description: Dimming level (0 for OFF and 100% for ON) measured on the outdoor lamp controller.

Default_dimming_level.label: Default dimming level
Default_dimming_level.description: The default dimming level that the outdoor lamp controller applies when the device is powered ON.

Lamp_failure.label: Lamp failure
Lamp_failure.description: Set to True if the outdoor lamp controller detects that the lamp is not producing light while it is expected to (e.g. the lamp is broken).

Lamp_failure_reason.label: Lamp failure reason
Lamp_failure_reason.description: Description of the reason why the lamp failed (e.g. low power on a LED engine, no consumption detected while relay closed).

Control_gear_failure.label: Control gear failure
Control_gear_failure.description: Set to True in case the control gear has a failure. Outdoor lamp controllers may read the control gear failure from a DALI bus or by analyzing a 0-10 volts interface to the control gear.

Control_gear_failure_reason.label: Control gear failure reason
Control_gear_failure_reason.description: Description of the reason why the control gear failed. You may refer to the DiiA list of possible control gear failures.

Relay_failure.label: Relay failure
Relay_failure.description: Set to True if the outdoor lamp controller detects that its relay is not operating as it is expected to.

Day_burner.label: Day burner
Day_burner.description: Set to True in case the lamp is ON while it should be OFF (e.g. day burner).

Cycling_failure.label: Cycling failure
Cycling_failure.description: Set to True if the outdoor lamp controller detects that the lamp is switching ON and OFF too often.

Control_gear_communication_failure.label: Control gear communication failure
Control_gear_communication_failure.description: Set to True in case the control gear (e.g. LED driver) does not answer on the DALI bus.

Scheduler_ID.label: Scheduler ID
Scheduler_ID.description: Identifier(s) of the scheduler(s) that are assigned to the Command of this outdoor lamp controller.

Invalid_scheduler.label: Invalid scheduler
Invalid_scheduler.description: Set to True when one of the schedulers can’t be executed or is not supported by the outdoor lamp controller. Otherwise set to False.

Lamp_operating_hours.label: Lamp operating hours
Lamp_operating_hours.description: Cumulated number of hours during which the lamp has been ON with a strictly positive dimming level.

Lamp_ON_timestamp.label: Lamp ON timestamp
Lamp_ON_timestamp.description: Last date and time at which the lamp switched ON, i.e. from no light to light (e.g. power off to power on and/or dim level = 0 to dim level > 0).

Lamp_switch_counter.label: Lamp switch counter
Lamp_switch_counter.description: Number of times the lamp was switched from ON to OFF since the last lamp switch counter reset.

Control_gear_start_counter.label: Control gear start counter
Control_gear_start_counter.description: Number of times the control gear was switched from ON to OFF.

Control_gear_temperature.label: Control gear temperature
Control_gear_temperature.description: Temperature measured by the control gear and transmitted to the device through DALI, Zhaga D4i or equivalent.

Control_gear_thermal_derating.label: Control gear thermal derating
Control_gear_thermal_derating.description: Set to True if the control gear has derated the light source due to high temperature.

Control_gear_thermal_derating_counter.label: Control gear thermal derating counter
Control_gear_thermal_derating_counter.description: Number of time the control gear has derated the light source due to a high temperature, since last counter reset.

Control_gear_thermal_shutdown.label: Control gear thermal shutdown
Control_gear_thermal_shutdown.description: Set to True if the control gear has shut the light source down due to high temperature.

Control_gear_thermal_shutdown_counter.label: Control gear thermal shutdown counter
Control_gear_thermal_shutdown_counter.description: Number of times the control gear has shutdown the light source since last counter reset.

Output_port.label: Output port
Output_port.description: Address or reference of the output port (e.g. DALI port address or 1-10 volt output) in case of multiple control gears.

Standby_mode.label: Standby mode
Standby_mode.description: Set to True if the outdoor lamp controller should keep its relay closed (control gear is powered ON) when command and/or dimming level is equal to 0. Set to False if the outdoor lamp controller should open its relay (control gear is not powered ON) when command and/or dimming level is equal to 0.

Constant_light_output.label: Constant light output
Constant_light_output.description: Set to True to activate Constant Light Output dimming correction on the outdoor lamp controller. Set to False to deactivate Constant Light Output.

Cleaning_factor_enabled.label: Cleaning factor enabled
Cleaning_factor_enabled.description: Light output of a luminaire may depend on the lamp cleaning factor. Cleaning factor may be used as a light output compensation. Set to True to activate lamp cleaning correction on the outdoor lamp controller. Set to False to deactivate the lamp cleaning correction.

Cleaning_period.label: Cleaning period
Cleaning_period.description: Number of days after which cleaning factor is back to 100%.

Initial_lamp_cleaning_factor.label: Initial lamp cleaning factor
Initial_lamp_cleaning_factor.description: Initial lamp cleaning correction factor to multiply to the command when the luminaire is cleaned, at the lamp cleaning date.

Lamp_cleaning_date.label: Lamp cleaning date
Lamp_cleaning_date.description: Date at which the luminaire was last (or will be next) cleaned and the lamp cleaning factor should be set to the initial lamp cleaning factor.

Control_type.label: Control type
Control_type.description: Type of control system with whioch the outdoor lamp controller switches, dims and monitors the lamp. The possible control types are: 0: No dimming control, 1 : DALI part 201 - Device Type 0, 2 : DALI part 202 - Device Type 1, 3 : DALI part 203 - Device Type 2, 4 : DALI part 204 - Device Type 3, 5 : DALI part 205 - Device Type 4, 6 : DALI part 206 - Device Type 5, 7 : DALI part 207 - Device Type 6, 8 : DALI part 208 - Device Type 7, 9 : DALI part 209 - Device Type 8, 10 : 0-10V, 11 : PWM, 12 : PWM_N, 13 : Other

Nominal_Lamp_wattage.label: Nominal Lamp wattage
Nominal_Lamp_wattage.description: Active power of the light source at 100% dimming level.

Minimum_dimming_level.label: Minimum dimming level
Minimum_dimming_level.description: Minimum dimming level under which the lamp will most probably not operate.

Minimum_lamp_wattage.label: Minimum lamp wattage
Minimum_lamp_wattage.description: Expected active power of the light source at its minimum dimming level. This value may be used to detect failure at low dimming level.

Light_color_temperature_command.label: Light color temperature command
Light_color_temperature_command.description: Latest light color temperature command sent to the lamp actuator.

Actual_light_color_temperature.label: Actual light color temperature
Actual_light_color_temperature.description: The actual light color temperature of the light source.

Virtual_power_output.label: Virtual power output
Virtual_power_output.description: Percentage of nominal power at which the light source should be set when the Command is set to 100%.

Voltage_at_max_dim_level.label: Voltage at max dim level
Voltage_at_max_dim_level.description: Voltage level on the control port that corresponds to maximum dimming level. This applies only if Control Type = 0-10V.

Voltage_at_min_dim_level.label: Voltage at min dim level
Voltage_at_min_dim_level.description: Voltage level on the control port that corresponds to minimum dimming level. This applies only if Control Type = 0-10V.

Light_source_voltage.label: Light source voltage
Light_source_voltage.description: Voltage (usually DC voltage) to the light source or generic load, measured at the output of the control gear.

Light_source_current.label: Light source current
Light_source_current.description: Current (usually DC current) delivered by the control gear to the light source or generic load, measured at the output of the control gear.

Light_source_active_power.label: Light source active power
Light_source_active_power.description: Active power of the light source or generic load, measured at the output of the control gear.

Light_source_active_energy.label: Light source active energy
Light_source_active_energy.description: Cumulated active energy consumption of the light source or generic load, measured at the output of the control gear.

Lamp_operating_hours_reset.label: Lamp operating hours reset
Lamp_operating_hours_reset.description: Reset of the lamp operating hours counter.

Control_gear_thermal_derating_counter_re.label: Control gear thermal derating counter reset
Control_gear_thermal_derating_counter_re.description: Reset of the control gear shutdown counter.
